name: dba-database-skills
description: Five version-aware DBA skills for SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL and MariaDB, covering relational design, SQL, operations and safe change planning.

interface.longDescription: A skills-only collection for DBAs and database engineers using SQL Server 2022/2025, PostgreSQL 18, MySQL 9.7 LTS and MariaDB 13.0. The five Spanish-language skills guide relational modeling and normalization through 3NF, version-aware SQL, performance analysis, security, backups, high availability and migration planning. They provide instructions and reference material only: no database connections, credentials, executable operations or production guarantees. Verify engine, build, edition, platform and business rules before relying on a recommendation.
defaultPrompt: Use the skill for the exact database engine and version to review this schema through 3NF. State which business rules need confirmation before proposing DDL.
Diagnose this SQL performance issue for the exact server build. Separate evidence, hypotheses and tests; do not invent measurements.
Review this database change for transaction, locking, backup, recovery and version-specific risks.

publication.release_notes: Initial skills-only package with five version-aware DBA workflows for SQL Server 2022/2025, PostgreSQL 18, MySQL 9.7 LTS and MariaDB 13.0.
